Hygieniaan kannattaa kiinnittää erityistä huomiota ja juoda pullotettua vettä. Erilaisia vatsa- ja suolistotauteja aiheuttavia bakteereja kuten salmonellaa esiintyy. Kuumimpaan kesäaikaan joissakin kaupungeissa (Teheran, Esfahan) on ilmennyt myös koleratapauksia.

Iraniin kohdistuvista kansainvälisistä pakotteista johtuen kaikkia lääkkeitä ei ole aina saatavilla.

Maan lait ja käytännöt

Iranin hallintojärjestelmä perustuu uskonnolliseen johtajuuteen ja soveltaa laajasti sharia-lakia. Kaikkien tulee noudattaa islamilaisia pukeutumissääntöjä: naisilla hiukset ja niskan peittävä huivi, polvipituinen väljähkö takki sekä nilkat peittävä vaatetus. Miesten on pidettävä pitkiä housuja, mutta lämpimään vuodenaikaan miehet voivat käyttää myös lyhythihaisia t-paitoja. Virallisissa tapaamisissa asun on oltava peittävä, solmiota ei tarvitse käyttää. Syksyllä surukuukauden (muharam) aikana kannattaa pukeutua tummiin väreihin. Surukuukauden aika vaihtuu vuosittain. Monessa moskeijassa edellytetään naisilta sisäänpääsyyn shadoria, jota voi lainata moskeijan vahtimestareilta. Jos moskeija vaatii kenkien riisumista, omat sukat on hyvä olla mukana.

Iranissa miesten ja naisten välisessä kanssakäymisessä noudatetaan sääntöjä, joita tulee noudattaa. Seksuaalinen kanssakäyminen on sallittu vain avioliitossa, vapaata seurustelua ei hyväksytä. Teheranin ulkopuolella hotelli voi joskus pyytää esittämään vihkitodistuksen todisteeksi avioliitosta, jos mies ja nainen aikovat yöpyä samassa huoneessa. Julkisia hellyydenosoituksia eri sukupuolten välillä saattaa joskus nähdä suurissa kaupungeissa, mutta ne ovat virallisesti edelleen kiellettyjä.

Sopimattomasta käyttäytymisestä voi joutua rikosoikeudelliseen vastuuseen. Avioliiton ulkopuoliset suhteet ja homoseksuaalinen kanssakäyminen ovat lain mukaan rikoksia, joista voi seurata raipaniskuja tai jopa kuolemantuomio. Paikallisia moraalikäsityksiä koskevat säännöt etenkin julkisilla paikoilla pätevät myös ulkomaalaisiin. Sopimattomasta käytöksestä tai pukeutumisesta voi saada huomautuksia.

Sekä päihde- että siveettömyysrikoksista langetettavat rangaistukset ovat ankaria ja poikkeavat länsimaisista. Alkoholin maahantuonti ja nauttiminen on Iranissa kielletty, samoin huumausaineiden hallussapito ja käyttö. Iranissa annetaan vuosittain lukuisia kuolemantuomioita huumausainerikoksista.

Valokuvaamisessa tulee noudattaa erityistä varovaisuutta. Useiden rakennusten kuvaaminen on kielletty (mm. diplomaattiset edustustot, jotkut virastot, ydinvoimalaitokset, lentokentät, sotilaskohteet). Kiellosta ilmoitetaan usein liikennemerkillä. Kiellon rikkomisesta voi seurata ankara rangaistus. Ulkomaalaisia on pidätetty sensitiivisten kohteiden valokuvaamisesta, mutta myös hyvin vähäpätöisiltä ja satunnaisilta vaikuttavien asioiden kuvaaminen voi aiheuttaa ongelmia. Poliisien valokuvaaminen on johtanut pidätyksiin. Suhtautuminen valokuvaukseen voi vaihdella, joten on syytä noudattaa varovaisuutta. Myös mielenosoitusten ja väenkokousten kuvaamista tulee välttää. Suurlähetystö suosittelee matkustajia pidättäytymään muiden kuin selkeiden turistikohteiden kuvauksesta. Luvaton droonien käyttö on kielletty.

Sosiaalisen median osalta on suositeltavaa noudattaa erityistä varovaisuutta ja harkintaa. Sosiaalinen media ja internet ovat Iranissa viranomaisten tarkan valvonnan ja sensuurin alaisia. Kriittisistä julkaisuista voi seurata rangaistuksia.

Iran ei tunnusta kaksoiskansalaisuutta. Iranin ja Suomen kaksoiskansalaisia pidetään Iranissa iranilaisina, joihin sovelletaan Iranin lakeja ja käytäntöjä. Kaksoiskansalaisten auttaminen ongelmatilanteissa voi olla vaikeaa tai jopa mahdotonta. Jos kaksoiskansalainen pidätetään, paikallisilla viranomaisilla ei ole velvollisuutta ilmoittaa tästä lähetystölle.

Ramadanin (paastokuukausi) aikana tulee ottaa huomioon islamin uskontoon perustuvat säännöt ja välttää syömistä, juomista tai tupakoimista julkisilla paikoilla auringonnousun ja auringonlaskun välisenä aikana.

Kansainväliset luotto- ja pankkikortit eivät toimi Iranissa eli käteistä kannattaa varata tarpeeksi koko matkan ajaksi. Rahaa voi vaihtaa lentokentällä, joissakin hotelleissa ja vaihtopisteissä. Iranissa on ollut käytössä keväästä 2018 alkaen rialin virallinen vaihtokurssi ja markkinakurssi.Valokuvaamiseen ja videokuvaamiseen liittyy monissa maissa rajoituksia. Mahdollisia kuvauskieltoja on syytä noudattaa. Yleensä esim. sotilaallisten laitosten, lentokenttien tai satamien valokuvaaminen ja videokuvaaminen on kielletty, ja kielto koskee myös ilmakuvausta drooneilla. Myös droonien maahantuonti voi vaatia erillisiä lupaprosesseja. Varmista tarvittaessa rajoitukset etukäteen paikallisviranomaisilta. Kiellettyjä kohteita kuvaava henkilö saatetaan ottaa kiinni tai pidättää, ja kuvauslaitteet saatetaan tuhota tai takavarikoida.

Valokuvaamiseen ja videokuvaamiseen liittyy rajoituksia. Mahdollisia kuvauskieltoja on syytä noudattaa. Sotilaskohteiden, lentoasemien ja satamien sekä muiden hallintorakennusten valokuvaaminen ja videokuvaaminen on kielletty. Kielto koskee myös ilmakuvausta drooneilla. Droonien maahantuonti voi vaatia erillisiä lupaprosesseja. Varmista tarvittaessa rajoitukset etukäteen paikallisviranomaisilta. Kiellettyjä kohteita kuvaava henkilö saatetaan ottaa kiinni tai pidättää, ja kuvauslaitteet saatetaan tuhota tai takavarikoida.

Internetin sisältöä sensuroidaan, ja sen käyttöä valvotaan laajasti. Myös sosiaalista mediaa ja viestisovelluksia seurataan aktiivisesti. Microsoft's NTLM security changes trip up third-party logins
items.summary: Microsoft's November security updates can break authentication in some third-party applications and devices following changes to NTLM message signing. Affected systems include authentication proxy servers, single sign-on (SSO) products, and application packaging tools, the company's support notice says. The failures stem from products that claim to supply required information during NTLM authentication but return incomplete or empty data, Microsoft said: "An affected device might set the NTLMSSP_NEGOTIATE_TARGET_INFO flag in its CHALLENGE_MESSAGE but provide an empty or incomplete TargetInfo field." Administrators can use the notice's network trace and event log examples to identify affected products. For confirmed cases, the temporary workaround is to set the ClientAllowUnsignedNtlm Registry value to 1 on affected clients. This stops the client offering signing, backing out the new default rather than fixing the incompatible product. The recommended long-term options are a vendor update or Kerberos authentication, where supported.

items.title: Inside Agentic Offensive Frameworks: Intent IDs
items.summary: What are Intent IDs? Intent IDs are incrementing counters in common agentic offensive frameworks. They are an internal implementation detail: the harness breaks an attack into discrete sub-goals called "intents" and assigns each one a numeric ID. When a harness places that ID in its prompts and workspace paths, it bleeds into the attack: when the model creates a file, registers an account, pushes a GitHub workflow, or sets a User-Agent string on a target, it borrows the identifier sitting right in front of it. There has been a proliferation of agentic offensive frameworks. We reviewed over a hundred open-source offensive harness repositories, and two families stand out for handing the LLM a numeric Intent ID that leaks into target-side artifacts: - The ARTEX family: ARTEX itself, plus public forks like Pojun (tracking current ARTEX as of v0.4.99) and AntiFox (forked from ARTEX v0.1.1). - The Cairn family: Cairn itself and descendants like sapper-v2 (a reimplementation of Cairn's design).

items.title: How to protect against preinstalled Android malware
items.summary: Preinstalled malware on mobile devices is a major threat to user security and privacy. When we buy a new smartphone or tablet, we expect it to be ready to use and secure right out of the box. In some cases, however, devices ship with malware already on them. Such malware can do almost anything: display ads, collect personal data and credentials, track user activity, and more. Preinstalled malware can also turn the infected device into a tool for fraud, such as stealing credit card numbers or other sensitive information, causing financial loss and reputational damage. We’ve previously reported cases where users bought smartphones on marketplaces with malware already preinstalled. Over the past few months, however, several large organizations have encountered malware embedded in the firmware of mobile devices. The specific risks to corporate security depend on how the devices are used and on the company’s line of business. But because the Trojan sits in the device firmware, any app can be compromised, and the potential damage is hard to overstate. This post looks at the current landscape of preinstalled threats on mobile devices, the risks they pose to corporate users, and available countermeasures, including Kaspersky solutions.

items.title: CISA warns of critical unpatched flaw in Danfoss refrigeration controllers
items.summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning about a critical vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controllers used by food retailers to manage commercial refrigeration, HVAC, and lighting systems. Danfoss controllers have been compromised recently in attacks at various supermarkets and food retailers across Europe where hackers remotely shut down cooling systems or raised their temperatures. The security issue is tracked as CVE-2026-129713 and received a severity score of 9.8. It is a stack-based buffer overflow in the controller’s server. CISA says an attacker can trigger the flaw without authentication, cause the server to restart, and potentially achieve remote code execution with the web server's privileges. Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA controllers are central control units for supermarket and convenience-store refrigeration. They are used to manage equipment such as refrigerated display cases and compressor racks, to log temperatures, and to alert when changes occur. Danfoss calls the product line the AK-SM 800A Series, which includes the 820A, 850A, and 880A models. Depending on the model, they can also control store lighting and HVAC. CISA notes that the controllers are deployed worldwide, but their exact number remains unclear.

items.title: InfraTrust warns of exploited supply chain flaws in network appliances
items.summary: Eclypsium's November InfraTrust report warns that most infrastructure security advisories addressing exploited vulnerabilities over the past month involve flaws in third-party software bundled into products rather than code developed by the vendors themselves. The November InfraTrust Pulse report tracks 373 new security advisories published by 23 infrastructure vendors between October 15 and November 19, covering 3,880 vulnerabilities. Of these advisories, 98 were rated critical, and 38 contained vulnerabilities listed in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. However, 33 of those 38 advisories fixed exploited flaws in bundled software components, primarily PHP, Node.js, and OpenSSH. These vulnerabilities pose additional risks for enterprises, as even after a software developer releases a security fix, organizations must wait for infrastructure vendors to incorporate it into their products. "Your exposure to exploited flaws depends on how quickly each vendor rebuilds its products after an upstream fix ships," the report reads. An example of this is the two PHP vulnerabilities known as PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) highlighted in last month's InfraTrust report, which are now being exploited in attacks against Palo Alto Networks and Check Point firewalls.

items.title: The security of US water systems is even leakier than we thought
items.summary: American water systems are even less secure than we thought, according to a study of 236 technology vendors that provide gear to US drinking water, wastewater, and industrial water systems. The federal government has issued 4,014 security advisories for industrial control systems and cataloged 1,792 vulnerabilities known to have been exploited in cyberattacks. A new index, called Water Supply Chain Watch and published by exposure management firm Securin, however, found almost twice as many vulnerabilities as public records identified – including 20 exploited flaws that weren't even in the federal government's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog. The security provider compared data on water-tech vendors with records from the US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA), the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), the FBI, and WaterISAC, drawing on CISA advisory data through November 20 and KEV catalog entries through November 23. It found that federal water advisories hit their highest level this year since 2020.

items.title: FIFA says hackers accessed ‘limited set of personal and business information’
items.summary: The Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA) confirmed that internal data was stolen during a recent cyberattack. The Switzerland-based soccer organization said hackers breached its systems and gained “unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information.” "FIFA is working closely with the relevant authorities, including law enforcement,” a spokesperson said. "FIFA condemns in the strongest possible terms the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data. Such actions constitute a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy and can have significant consequences for the individuals concerned." The organization did not respond to follow up questions about the nature of the incident. FIFA is the governing body of international soccer and organizes the World Cup, which was held this summer. It has about 700 employees and is headquartered in Zurich. The Handsome Boy Hacking Club (HBHC) cybercriminal group claimed last week that it stole more than 12 GB of data from the organization and attempted to extort FIFA but failed.

items.title: Suspected ransomware attack disrupts cancer treatments, surgeries at Guadeloupe hospital
items.summary: France’s national cybersecurity agency is investigating a suspected ransomware attack that impaired the computer systems of the University Hospital of Guadeloupe, forcing doctors to postpone surgeries, suspend some cancer treatments and revert to pen and paper. France’s national cybersecurity agency, known as ANSSI, said Tuesday the incident appeared to involve ransomware and that investigators were examining whether hackers gained access to the hospital’s systems through an unnamed IT supplier that was reportedly compromised several months ago. French prosecutors have launched a criminal investigation into the incident. It remains unclear who was behind the attack. The hospital’s management told local media on Monday that it had not received a ransom demand and ruled out paying a ransom. The hospital — the largest on the French Caribbean island of approximately 380,000 residents — said on its website it had canceled some surgical procedures, medical consultations and imaging tests through at least Friday. Radiation therapy has been temporarily suspended over safety concerns, while chemotherapy sessions scheduled for Monday were canceled. The hospital is reviewing upcoming appointments based on each patient’s medical needs. Emergency services, dialysis treatments and urgent cardiac procedures remain available. The hospital has asked residents to visit its emergency departments only if they need immediate medical care.

items.title: Hackers reportedly breached CIA intelligence analysis system
items.summary: ​Unknown attackers have reportedly breached an open-source intelligence (OSINT) analysis system at the US Central Intelligence Agency (CIA), according to a source familiar with the matter. The source told The New York Times, which first reported the incident, that the cyberattack was carried out using the ARTEX AI-powered penetration testing framework and also affected the Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) and the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency. While the CIA and the ODNI have not yet replied to a request for more details regarding this incident, no classified data or systems were exposed in the breach. "The hack did not involve our classified networks or classified information, and no other systems are currently at risk," the source said. Hours after the CIA security breach was reported, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) also disclosed that it's investigating a cybersecurity incident involving unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems. After detecting the attack, the agency took some systems offline as a precaution and told banks to use the Financial Institutions Hotline to file reports, since some services may be unavailable. "Treasury is working with the Federal Bureau of Investigation, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, and third-party forensic examiners to determine the scope and impact of the incident," a FinCEN official told BleepingComputer. "In the meantime, as a proactive measure, we have taken certain FinCEN systems offline and provided exceptive relief for filers that are not able to submit reports as a result of the disruption."

items.title: US Treasury financial crimes unit becomes latest fed breach victim
items.summary: The US Treasury's Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) has taken some systems offline following unauthorized access, disrupting regulatory filings for financial institutions. An alert has gone up on FinCEN's Bank Secrecy Act E-Filing website, as shown in this archived copy, informing those who need to submit reports that they might not be able to while the agency deals with the situation. FinCEN not only enforces compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act and associated regulations but also collects and analyzes financial intelligence for sharing with other US agencies and foreign government partners. In other words, it has some juicy info in its databases. “FinCEN is investigating a cybersecurity incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems,” the alert states. “As a proactive measure, FinCEN has taken some systems offline.” FinCEN hasn't said which systems intruders accessed, but clues in the deadline extension notice the agency posted alongside the warning suggest the disruption affects its reporting services for banks and other financial institutions required to submit reports detailing certain financial transactions and suspicious activity that may indicate money laundering or other illicit activity.

items.title: What defenders need to know about ARTEX, the agentic AI framework threat actors abuse
items.summary: Since its release in July 2026, the AI-powered penetration testing framework ARTEX has been abused by many threat actors to accelerate their existing workflows related to network reconnaissance, credential attacks, and web application exploitation. As of November 2026, Microsoft Threat Intelligence has observed both state-sponsored and financially motivated threat actors such as Storm-0940, Storm-3358, Onyx Sleet, Pearl Sleet, Crystal Typhoon, and Salt Typhoon integrating ARTEX into their tooling. In the past few weeks, we’ve reported several distinct campaigns that abused ARTEX to search public repositories for exposed secrets, enable supply chain compromise, and scan internet-facing systems for exploitation. These campaigns illustrate how threat actors use ARTEX to automate various stages of the attack chain. Threat actors define scope and targets for ARTEX, which then uses AI agents to set verifiable goals, define tactical steps for each stage of the operation, use tools to attack targets, create graphs to track discovered systems and results of actions, and report back to the threat actor. Depending on the threat actor’s configuration and the target’s defenses, ARTEX can advance from reconnaissance to persistent, privileged access to a target organization in a matter of minutes. ARTEX does not introduce new attack techniques; it uses common, pre-existing penetration testing tools and techniques. ARTEX does sometimes transmit distinctive characteristics associated with its integrated penetration testing tools. However, threat actors using ARTEX can and do vary network indicators like source IP address or user agent string, especially to bypass static or simple signature-based detection and blocking. The most reliable and durable signal of ARTEX activity is behavioral: ARTEX sends a wide variety of requests in a brief time and retries variations on the same technique or moves on to next-stage actions at machine speed.
